by: Claude (AI) before any retrieval number existed
about: 75 questions, 15 per Act, written from the Act's own section list and text. AI-marked, NOT a lawyer's list: 'expected' = the section(s) Claude judges answer the question; 'also_ok' = other sections that would be a reasonable first look (counted only in the lenient score). 'hard' = Claude expected retrieval to struggle (guess made before the run). Never edit a question after a run to improve a score; a mistake in the key is corrected only with a note in 'corrections_log'.
